en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), and the Couplets on the Dissociated from the Taints and the Subject to Taints (Āsavavippayuttasāsavaduka).
Conditioned by a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, dissociated from the taints, yet subject to the taints,

there arises a phenomenon that is non-non-demonstrable, non-reactive, dissociated from the taints, and not subject to the taints, by way of root condition. Conditioned by a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable,
non-reactive, dissociated from the taints, yet subject to the taints, there arises a phenomenon that is non-non-demonstrable, reactive, dissociated from the taints, and not subject to the taints.

By way of root condition: conditioned by a non-visible, non-obstructive state that is dissociated from the taints but is itself subject to taints, there arise states that are neither visible nor obstructive, dissociated from the taints, and not subject to taints, as well as states that are neither non-visible nor obstructive, dissociated from the taints, and not subject to taints, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are three.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, dissociated from the taints, and untainted,
there arises a state that is non-non-demonstrable, non-non-reactive, dissociated from the taints, and not-untainted, by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, dissociated from the taints, and untainted, there arises a state that is non-not-demonstrable-and-reactive, dissociated from the taints, and not-untainted...

...arises by way of root condition ...pe... dependent on a non-demonstrable, non-reactive state that is dissociated from the taints and is itself untainted, there arise states that are neither demonstrable nor reactive, dissociated from the taints, and not untainted, and states that are neither non-demonstrable nor reactive, dissociated from the taints, and not untainted, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition]:
Six by way of predominance; six ... [and so on] ... six by way of non-disappearance.
